digest.component_or_area: llm model construction and fallback chains
propositions: A class may specify a fallback array to provide alternative models when the primary is unreachable, down, or rate-limited, rather than failing outright.

The fallback_on predicate must be set deliberately to classify errors into retryable conditions (RETRY_NOW, WAIT_AND_RETRY, CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL) and exclude loud-failure cases (CHANGE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_INPUT, INCREASE_PROVIDER_LIMITS).

Fallback entries carry inline model configs including endpoint, which must be honored during construction; each sub-model must share the same ProviderSession and be entered/exited as an async context manager.

Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection from all candidates (primary plus fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is built; capabilities_for() must never be called on a FallbackModel instance.
The ran_model verdict must be read from ModelResponse.model_name (which identifies the actual responding model), never from FallbackModel.model_name (which returns a synthetic combined string).

The fallback_on condition must be a callable predicate derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL to ensure automatic propagation of taxonomy changes without manual drift.
